singleSourced.context: "There's an interesting story with the DMZ beta, where we had to make some decisions," studio multiplayer creative director Joe Cecot said in a recent behind-the-scenes video (below).
These range from being free to costing a whopping $100,000 in DMZ Cash per deployment.
The next infil option costs $5,000 and spawns the squad in a Polaris Dagor A1, a tactical off-road vehicle, offering a significant speed advantage.
If you're willing to spend $25,000 to deploy, meanwhile, you'll do so in a Light Tactical Vehicle (LTV), which has considerably more armour.
Then there's the $50,000 option, which spawns the squad in a helicopter, which represents an enormous advantage over people spawning on foot.
